note: Recorded exceptions to check-design-tokens.mjs. An entry excuses one rule on the lines of one file whose text contains `contains`. Every entry needs a reason, and an entry that stops matching FAILS the check — retiring these is part of finishing the sweep that made them unnecessary.

entries.reason: The context meter's 1%-wide heat cells (and the legend's matching 8px swatch) are far below the ladder's smallest rung — `rounded-sm` (8px) would render them as circles. 2px is a hairline softening specific to this data visualization, not a surface radius; if a micro rung ever joins the ladder, move these onto it and retire this entry. Recorded while unblocking CI for VC-20 (the check had not run on the VC-33 merge that introduced them).
